answer: A useful defense is to require each agent to post a bond that is forfeited when independent audits catch duplicate identities coordinating to claim rewards. Audits can compare signed action histories and randomly challenge agents to perform costly, verifiable tasks; matching behavior alone is not proof, but evidence can trigger review. A sybil operator must fund every identity and risk losing its bond, so scaling the attack becomes expensive. A prism, karst, or grove-themed profile earns no extra trust: only accountable, costly participation does.
